evidence: decorative_mascot: Data has no setup->action->payoff bit: he perches on whatever shape is nearest and slides — atop the 105 bubble at seg1:start, leaning on the Millennials bar at seg2:start, standing on the purple bar at seg3:start, then drifting down it unchanged across seg4:start/mid/end.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start, seg3:mid and again at seg4:start/mid/end the two bar captions are stamped on the same baseline and render as unreadable mush — 'Wealthiest 2% of hou' and 'The other 98% of households' collide into 'ofThe othe 98%' — they also bleed past the left card edge and sit on top of the source credit line; the kicker 'WEALTHIEST 2% OF HOUSEHOLDS VS THE OTHER 98%' is clipped by the right frame edge in the same frames.
weakest_scene.root_cause: Both category labels are placed at a fixed centered anchor per bar without measuring text width against the bar column, so long strings overrun their column and overlap each other and the footer; the kicker uses the same unconstrained width and overflows the safe area.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Lay out the two comparison labels inside their own bar columns with width-aware wrapping/shrink-to-fit above the source line so 'Wealthiest 2%' and 'The other 98%' are separately legible, keep all text inside the card's safe margins, and put the $62T value on the pink bar as well as the purple so the 'same as the other 98% combined' equality reads visually.
